description: Issues the user's PDF résumé from their developer profile, as Developer panel → PDF résumé does: A4, with UpFork's seal, a number and a QR code anyone can check at upfork.dev/verify. Returns the link where the user downloads it (signed in on upfork.dev) and its check page. Developers with a public page only; up to 10 a day, and the same profile in the same look on the same day gives back the same document.

accent.description: Its colour: ink (the default), blue, green or plum.

phone.description: Put the phone on it (only if their phone isn't kept to themselves).

photo.description: Put the profile's photo on it.

products.description: Up to 6 of their own products to show, by slug, in order; leave out for the ones their page leads with.

name: make_resume

downloadUrl.description: Where the user downloads the PDF: on upfork.dev, signed in.

leftToday.description: How many new résumés are left today.

number.description: Its number, printed on it: R-XXXX-XXXX.

products.description: The products on it, by slug.

reused.description: True when the same profile in the same look was already issued today: this is that document.

verifyUrl.description: Where anyone checks it (the QR code on it leads there).

title: Make your PDF résumé
